ConsultantHomeView.awaitingQuestionnaires lists each active company once by its newest unanswered send ({ companyId, name, sentAt, waitingDays }), longest wait first. acceptance.AC-ra-48: After POST /api/companies/:id/questionnaire the company is listed in awaitingQuestionnaires and opens under ?attention=aguardando with its send date. Covered in tests/api/questionnaireRoutes.test.ts.
acceptance.AC-ra-51: After the answers import the company leaves awaitingQuestionnaires and the aguardando filter; GET /api/companies/:id/timeline carries draft.clientAnswersSavedAt (ISO) for the imported draft, with the date of the file that replaced a previous draft, kept while the draft is worked on, and absent for a draft the owner started. Covered in tests/api/questionnaireRoutes.test.ts (describe 'the imported draft in the company timeline').

findings.summary: awaitingQuestionnaires (IF-008) and draft.clientAnswersSavedAt (IF-011) are left OUT of the response while empty, instead of being always present ([] / null).
findings.detail: Two pre-existing tests outside this unit's allowed files assert the exact objects with toEqual: tests/api/homeRoutes.test.ts:653-668 (the empty consultant view, no awaitingQuestionnaires) and tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts:231-244 (the open draft, no clientAnswersSavedAt). Both tests are in this unit's Done-when, so an always-present [] / null would fail them and I may not edit them. The fields are therefore optional in the TypeScript types (ConsultantHomeView.awaitingQuestionnaires?, TimelineDraft.clientAnswersSavedAt?). Consumers must read awaitingQuestionnaires ?? [] and clientAnswersSavedAt ?? null.

messages.text: To make the two fields always present as IF-008/IF-011 say: (1) in tests/api/homeRoutes.test.ts add `awaitingQuestionnaires: []` to the exact consultant view at ~line 663; (2) in tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts add `clientAnswersSavedAt: null` to the exact draft at ~line 233; (3) then drop the `?` from ConsultantHomeView.awaitingQuestionnaires in server/services/portfolioService.ts and make buildPortfolio always assign it, and make toDraft in server/services/historyService.ts always emit `clientAnswersSavedAt: clientSavedAt?.toISOString() ?? null`. Until then both fields are omitted while empty.

GET /api/home?mode=consultant now may carry awaitingQuestionnaires: Array<{ companyId, name, sentAt (ISO), waitingDays }> - the newest unanswered send of each active company, longest wait first. The key is ABSENT when nobody waits: read `home.awaitingQuestionnaires ?? []` (ConsultantHome.tsx, homeApi.ts). GET /api/companies?attention=aguardando is valid and returns exactly those companies (CompaniesPage.tsx filter). GET /api/companies/:id/timeline: draft.clientAnswersSavedAt (ISO string) exists only for a draft born from imported client answers; absent otherwise, so type it `clientAnswersSavedAt?: string | null` (already done in src/api/historyApi.ts TimelineDraft) and show 'Respostas do cliente, salvas em {data}' only when it is a string.

buildPortfolio(records, at, intervalDays?, awaitingSends = []) keeps its old call shape (tests/unit/portfolioDocument.test.ts and forbiddenTerms.test.ts call it with 2-3 args). PortfolioService.read loads the sends through PortfolioRepository.listAwaitingSends, which delegates to createQuestionnaireRepository(prisma).listAwaiting(); a send of an archived company is dropped in awaitingOf because the portfolio lists only active companies. The portfolio PDF is unchanged (PortfolioRow has no awaiting field).
